title: Tournament Registration Checklist
subtitle: Capture division placement, roster, schedule, and rules acknowledgment; confirm credential and result route.
description: Tournament Registration records division placement, roster, schedule, rules acknowledgment, credential, and result route. Tournament Registration evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this tournament registration stage-gated verification when staff must document division placement and roster. Reconcile schedule, rules acknowledgment, credential, and result route before the tournament registration handoff. Use the entry application, eligibility source, roster and substitutes, division capacity, schedule acknowledgment, rules receipt, credential record, and placement notice. This registration places a team or entrant into a competitive division using eligibility, roster and substitutes, seeding inputs, bracket capacity, rules receipt, and credential issue. Capture team-manager authority, age or weight classification where applicable, roster lock, jersey or bib assignment, club affiliation, ranking evidence, and officials' packet readiness. Ask the assigned tournament registration reviewer to confirm division placement against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Tournament Registration starting details
sections.guidance: Confirm division eligibility, roster and substitutes, schedule availability, rules receipt, credential issuance, seeding source, payment reference, and result route.

sections.title: Tournament Registration checks and corrections review
sections.guidance: Check current tournament registration facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Tournament Registration required checks
items: Division placement is identified for this record
Roster matches the current request or source
Schedule is ready for point-of-use staff
Rules acknowledgment limits or questions are resolved
Credential is communicated to the responsible person
Result route is confirmed at handoff
A changed tournament registration fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Tournament Registration failed or pending items

sections.title: Tournament Registration decision and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold tournament registration readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Tournament Registration reviewer receipt

fields.label: Event coordinator or responsible staff and date

blocks.guidance: Tournament Registration receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
